title: A week of every bus, tram and metro train in Rome
description:
A week of every bus, tram and metro train in Rome, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds. The feed has no FL regional trains, no Roma-Lido, Roma-Viterbo or Termini-Giardinetti trains and no Cotral buses, so they are not shown.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Rome city limits are faded and not counted. Colours: Metro, Tram and ATAC bus, with everything else in grey.

Busiest moment: 1,771 vehicles, Thursday at 8:30 am.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable. October 24 and October 25 are left out because the clocks change. Roma Servizi per la Mobilità starts its October timetable on October 9, so the earlier days are left out. Roma Servizi per la Mobilità has fewer than three usable October Sundays, so its Sunday uses one typical date.
